{"action":"done","summary":"All 220 tests pass (216 upstream + 4 acceptance_public.py). The implementation in src/cachetools/tagged.py satisfies all requirements R01-R08:

- R01: put(key,value,tags=()) with deep copy on input/output, tags validation (rejects bare string and non-string entries with ValueError before mutation), tag deduplication via set
- R02: invalidate(tag) returns count of removed entries, replacement removes old tag memberships, LRU eviction preserves no stale memberships, get refreshes LRU recency
- R03: maxsize validated as positive non-bool integer, invalid replacement leaves old state unchanged, values cost one capacity slot
- R04: invalidate_many(tags, mode='any'|'all') with union/intersection semantics, empty tags removes zero, invalid mode rejected before mutation
- R05: resize(maxsize) validates input first, preserves surviving entries and LRU order, shrinking evicts LRU, growing does not evict, failed resize preserves state, maxsize property reports capacity
- R06: Tags consumed once (generators supported via list() conversion), values deeply copied on get and put including nested structures
- R07: Constructor accepts timer=None (default time.monotonic), put accepts ttl=None (no expiry) or finite nonnegative int/float (not bool), invalid TTL raises ValueError before mutation, TTL=0 immediately expired
- R08: Expired entries removed before get/put/len/resize/invalidation without touching recency of surviving entries, overwriting replaces prior expiry, tag invalidation counts only live entries, missing/expired get raises KeyError"}
